prompts.before:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: high-resolution transparent archival poster cutout for a before/after restoration animation.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: a low-resolution photograph of a severely torn gold/yellow jazz concert poster lying on bright green backing, with wood beyond the backing.
Primary request: upscale the actual photographed poster to a very high resolution (prefer 2048 pixels on the long edge or larger), and precisely remove all green backing and wood/table background to genuine transparent alpha. Extract ALL original golden paper fragments, including the tiny disconnected pieces around the main torn poster. Every hole, missing area, and gap between fragments must be transparent.
Keep the visible ink, lettering, paper color, folds, torn boundaries, stains, tape, physical damage and relative positions of fragments as in the input. Preserve existing typography exactly; do not rewrite, invent, complete or fix ANY text. This is the BEFORE condition: do NOT restore or fill missing paper. Only enhance resolution gently, without adding fabricated detail.
Composition: portrait output, retain the original camera view and original relative fragment arrangement, whole group visible, tight transparent margin. No green mat, no tabletop, no replacement background, no shadow, no checkerboard baked into the pixels, no added labels. Output PNG with real transparency.
prompts.after:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: high-resolution transparent archival poster cutout for a before/after restoration animation.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: a low-resolution photograph of an already reconstructed golden/yellow jazz concert poster on a white mounting sheet with gray surface beyond.
Primary request: upscale the actual photographed poster to very high resolution (prefer 2048 pixels on the long edge or larger), and remove ALL surrounding white mounting paper, gray surface and cast shadow to genuine transparent alpha. Preserve only the complete golden/yellow rectangular concert poster itself.
Keep its exact photographed golden paper silhouette, black printed ink and all lettering, repairs, folds, stains, age spots and tape. This is an already restored historical object, so keep the current reconstruction EXACTLY. Preserve the visible typography and text exactly, including incomplete letters and illegibility. Do not rewrite, invent or complete any text. Only enhance resolution gently without fabricated detail.
Composition: portrait output, retain the original camera view, complete poster visible from its gently curved top edge to bottom corners, tight transparent margin. No mounting board, no frame, no shadow, no replacement background, no checkerboard baked in, no added labels. Output PNG with real transparency.
